title: Grilled Corn Elote
description: A classic Mexican dish smothered in a blend of spices, cheese, and herbs. This recipe adds a twist by grilling the corn, creating a smoky flavor that's perfect for any occasion.
instructions: Rinse the corn and remove the husks.
Grill the corn for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until slightly charred.
In a small bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, lime juice, chili powder, cumin, and salt.
Slather the mayonnaise mixture onto each ear of corn.
Sprinkle the cotija cheese over the corn.
Drizzle the unctuous (butter) over the corn.
Garnish with cilantro and serve immediately.
